channelList.description: On each key press the keyboard emits the note's MIDI pitch (plus continuous pitch-bend wheel offset in semitones) to the oscillators, which set/glide their base frequency accordingly; releasing the key clears that voice's pitch.
Key-down emits a gate-on event with velocity and key-up emits a gate-off event; the envelope uses these to start its attack/decay/sustain phase and trigger its release phase.
The mod wheel position (0-127) is streamed to the LFO section as a depth/amount scaler, increasing modulation intensity as the wheel is raised.
Continuously outputs the summed/mixed oscillator audio signal into the filter's input for spectral shaping.
Outputs the filtered audio signal into the effects chain input.
Streams the current envelope value to the filter, where it is scaled by the filter's Envelope Amount and added to cutoff for envelope-controlled filter sweeps.

channelList.id: Synthesizer: ADSR Envelope->Synthesizer: Master Output & Meter
channelList.description: Streams the current envelope value as the voice amplitude multiplier so notes fade in/out according to the ADSR shape, driving the output level and meter.
When destination is 'pitch', sends a bipolar LFO signal added to oscillator frequency for vibrato, scaled by depth and mod wheel.
When destination is 'cutoff', sends a bipolar LFO signal added to filter cutoff for filter movement, scaled by depth and mod wheel.

channelList.id: Synthesizer: LFO & Modulation->Synthesizer: Master Output & Meter
channelList.description: When destination is 'amplitude', sends a bipolar LFO signal that modulates the master gain for tremolo, scaled by depth and mod wheel.

channelList.id: Synthesizer: Effects Rack->Synthesizer: Master Output & Meter
channelList.description: Outputs the fully processed (wet/dry mixed) audio signal into the master output stage for final gain and metering.
On selecting/loading a preset, pushes the stored oscillator parameter set (waveforms, tuning, mix, sub, noise) to the oscillator bank, which applies them immediately.
On preset load, pushes stored filter type, cutoff, resonance, envelope amount, keytrack, and slope values, which the filter applies.
On preset load, pushes stored attack, decay, sustain, release, and velocity-amount values, which the envelope applies and redraws.
On preset load, pushes stored LFO rate, depth, waveform, sync, fade-in, and destination routing, which the LFO applies.
On preset load, pushes stored effect enable states, parameters, chain order, and wet/dry mix, which the effects rack applies.

channelList.id: Synthesizer: Preset Browser->Synthesizer: Master Output & Meter
channelList.description: On preset load, pushes stored master volume, pan, limiter, and mute states, which the master section applies.

On preset load, pushes stored arpeggiator on/off, mode, rate, octave range, step pattern, gate length, and swing settings, which the arpeggiator applies. Saving a preset captures the current state of all these components.

When enabled, generates timed note-on/note-off events from held notes according to mode, rate, octave range, and step grid, and sends them to the keyboard which highlights the corresponding keys and re-emits them into the voice chain.
